about: Plain-English adjustments for flp_adjust. Each word maps to concrete note ops (run by flh_compose on the song's patterns), optional mix intents (handed to the mix engineer when it is installed, otherwise reported as suggestions), sound hints and follow-up suggestions. 'roles' pick parts by detected role: drums, bass, chords, melody, counter, pad (or 'melodic' = everything except drums, 'all'). 'parts' narrows drums to kick/snare/hat/... by channel name. Amounts are for strength 1; 'a bit' halves them, 'much/way/a lot' scales by 1.5; 'less <word>' uses the 'opposite' word when there is one, otherwise the ops inverted. 'guess' says what is taste, so tools are honest about it.

op_kinds.swing: delta (ratio 0.5 straight .. 0.75) applied to notes on odd 16ths; current swing is measured first
op_kinds.accent: velocity added by position: downbeat (beats), backbeat (2 and 4, or 3 in half-time), offbeat (odd 16ths)
op_kinds.dynamics: range factor: >1 more contrast, <1 more even (around the part's mean velocity)
op_kinds.tighten: strength 0..1 toward the 1/16 grid (keeps swing ratio if keep_swing)
op_kinds.density: factor <1 removes the weakest notes (never downbeats or the backbeat); >1 adds 16th hats / ghost notes on drums
op_kinds.octave: octaves (+/-), only_if mean pitch is above/below a note
op_kinds.mode: to minor|major: parallel mode change of melodic parts (3rd, 6th, 7th degrees)
op_kinds.spread: widen chord voicings (drop-2) or narrow them (spread false)

bounce.about: more swing on the 16ths and a stronger downbeat/offbeat contrast in drums and bass
bounce.guess: how much swing feels good is taste; listen and use 'a bit' or 'much'

darker.about: lower register for chords and melody, softer and fewer bright hats, darker sounds/mix

sound.melody: darker timbre (less bright bell, more pad/piano)

darker.guess: register and tone only; harmony is unchanged (say 'sad' for minor)

brighter.about: higher register for chords/melody, crisper hats, brighter mix

harder.about: louder, more accented and tighter drums, firmer bass
mix: more saturation on drums and bass

aggressive.about: hard drums plus busier hats and accented bass; distortion in the mix

chill.about: softer, sparser, a little lazier and swung

emptier.about: fewer notes: weakest drum hits and melody/counter notes removed

busier.about: more drum activity (16th hats, ghost notes); for melodic parts add a layer or counter-melody
busier.guess: melodic parts are not invented by this word; use the suggestions

suggest: flp_perform_setup(style='natural') gives a full, editable performance (phrasing, swells)

tighter.about: timing pulled toward the grid (swing kept), more even velocities

wider.about: spread chord voicings; stereo width is a mix move

warmer.about: slightly lower chord register, longer notes, less harsh velocity; warmth is mostly a mix/sound move

dustier.about: lazier swing, looser timing, compressed dynamics; the dust itself is a mix/sound move
dustier.guess: vinyl/tape character needs effects; the note moves only loosen the groove

epic.about: octave-doubled melody and bass, accented drums, wider voicings; suggests adding strings/choir
suggest: flp_compose(what='layer', role='strings') or role='choir' for a big pad

sad.about: parallel minor (lowered 3rd, 6th, 7th) for melodic parts when the song is in major; slower-feeling, softer playing
sad.guess: a mode change rewrites harmony; already-minor songs only get the softer playing

happy.about: parallel major for melodic parts when the song is in minor; brighter, bouncier playing
happy.guess: a mode change rewrites harmony; check the melody still sings
